items.title: 9.5 Ethical, Legal, and Environmental Impacts of Computing (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu of topic 9.5: the text before its first sub-heading (PDF 135, printed 131).

blocks.text: Computing rozmarra zindagi ke bohat se pehluon par asar dalti hai. Technology ke ethical (akhlaqi) ya unethical (ghair-akhlaqi) asraat, legal (qanooni) ya illegal (ghair-qanooni) nataij ho sakte hain, aur yeh mahol (environment) par bhi asar dal sakti hai. Ethical istemal ka matlab hai digital tools use karte waqt munsifana aur zimmedarana faisle karna. Legal istemal technology se mutaliq qawaneen par chalta hai. Mahol par asar mein bijli ka kharch, electronic kachra (e-waste) aur fitrat par doosre asraat shamil hain. In asraat ka shaoor computing ke wasail use karte waqt samajhdari aur zimmedari ke faisle karne mein madad deta hai.

blocks.alt: Teen hisse: Akhlaqi (raazdari aur insaf; intellectual property ka ehtram), Qanooni (cybercrime par saza; GDPR (EU), PECA 2016 (Pakistan)), Mahoolyati (tawanai aur e-waste; reduce, reuse, recycle).
blocks.caption: Computing ke akhlaqi, qanooni aur mahoolyati asraat (is sabaq ke liye hamara apna khaaka; kitab mein yeh tasveer nahi).

blocks.prompt: Computing ke teen qism ke asraat (impacts) kaun se hain? Har aik ki aik misal dein.
blocks.explanation: Ethical: privacy aur insaf ka khayal. Legal: qawaneen ki pabandi (maslan hacking jurm hai). Environmental: bijli ka kharch aur electronic waste.

items: Computing ke ethical, legal aur environmental asraat hain.
In ki samajh se soch samajh kar aur zimmedarana faisle.
